caption:
"Say, "Come, I will recite what your Lord has prohibited to you. [He commands] that you not associate anything with Him, and to parents, good treatment, and do not kill your children out of poverty; We will provide for you and them. And do not approach immoralities - what is apparent of them and what is concealed. And do not kill the soul which Allah has forbidden [to be killed] except by [legal] right. This has He instructed you that you may use reason.""

Qur'an 6:151 (Surah Al-An'aam). Part 2 of 52 in our series on everything the Quran and the Prophet's hadith say about zina. Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese, Malay, Thai and Spanish.

Sources on the final slide.

#Quran #Chastity #IslamicReminder #Deen #Guidance

sourcing.primary_text: Qur'an 6:151, Surah Al-An'aam. Part of the zina series; passage chosen from api.alquran.cloud keyword searches (en.sahih: unlawful sexual intercourse, adultery, immorality, chaste, private parts, prostitution) and cross-checked by name.
sourcing.arabic: Edition quran-uthmani via api.alquran.cloud/v1/ayah/<ref>/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese,ms.basmeih,th.thai,es.cortes, one call per ayah (HTTP 200, fetched 2026-10-17); each ayah fetched twice and diffed identical; slide text written programmatically from the raw API fields (multi-ayah passages joined with a single space), no retyping.
sourcing.other_editions: en.sahih (Saheeh International), zh.jian (Ma Jian), ms.basmeih (Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih), th.thai (King Fahad Quran Complex), es.cortes (Julio Cortes): same call. ko.korean and ja.japanese: translator listed as unknown by source; slide says 'Translator not specified by source'.
sourcing.source_artifact_note: Artifact scan (double spaces, space before punctuation, leading/trailing whitespace, control chars) found none; slide text byte-identical to the API.
sourcing.compliance_check: Checked against 142 string terms in compliance-policy.json halal section across all edition text: hits = []. The text is scripture addressing the prohibition and legal treatment of zina; it is not promotional or explicit content.
